note:
The numbers the leveling planner needs that NO table in the pinned YuanShen dump publishes. Everything else it uses is derived into app/data/yuanshen/snapshot/planner_economy.json. This file is hand-maintained, which is why it lives outside snapshot/ -- that directory means 'derived from the pinned dump' and these are not.

RULE: an entry with a non-null value MUST carry a non-empty `source` naming where the number came from. tests/unit/test_planner_curated_rates.py enforces it. A null value is not a bug -- the planner reports that material's resin as unknown rather than guessing, which is the same discipline as 'a skipped check is never a pass'.

Why these specific entries: a world boss publishes an expected drop for its boss-specific material and NOTHING for the elemental gem branch, and the weekly-boss drops are absent for the same reason. Each gem Sliver below carries a family of four through the published 3:1 crafting tree, so one number prices four materials. See docs/RESEARCH_leveling_planner_data.md section 10.

character.comment: Mora charged per point of character EXP fed. Not in any of the 1,935 tables.

weapon.comment: Mora charged per point of weapon EXP fed.
